decisions.reason: As an experimental extension with still-unresolved demand and relatively limited carrying cost on an established specialist platform, the option value of keeping the white-label test vinyl series likely still exceeds the cost of withdrawing it.

Because the German new wave compilation series is close to the firm’s core collector-oriented catalog, launched only recently, and faces a growing retail backdrop with no visible negative signal, management would likely keep it on the market while uncertainty continues to resolve.
